notes.title: Autumn Update 2-15
notes.notes:
Hey you,

slowly the leaves turn their color and begin to fall and dance in the wind. The perfect season to play some strategy games with a cup of hot anything! For this reason we ease your journey by introduce some new features and a lot of fixes we collect the last months.

changes:
[list]
[*] Now you can move the camera in the evaluation screen after the reconnection to see the map more closely (thanks to T.Schaui for this suggestion <3)
[list]
[*] Zoom in - right trigger
[*] Left Stick - change position
[*] Mouse control is incomplete (coming soon..)
[/list]
[*] Updated game over screen
[list]
[*] The camera now centers on the Replicator which destroyed your base
[*] Fixed the time label, which always showed 00 00 00
[/list]
[*] Reconnection time (big circular loading bar, when you connect The Heart of Darkness) lowered by 20 seconds

[*] Fixed a huge bug when pressing A and B together in the building process

[*] Fixed the FTL (faster than light) mode, which was not working at all (last evolvement level of time)

[*] ANN save now needs more time to be activated - first round = 128 cycles; normal round = 64 cycles

[*] . . and a lot of minor graphical and functional changes
[/list]


Have fun and stay tuned =)

notes.title: Big Community Feedback Update 2-14
notes.notes:
[h1]Good News Everyone![/h1]

We spent the last month collecting your feedback and building the major update 2-14 to spice up your journey in RECONNECT. Meanwhile, people around us celebrating football, ice-cream and cold water to enjoy the summer, but not for us.. With our boiling heads and CPUs, we heated up the evolving summer even more, play tested hundreds of hours abstruse game-configurations, generated a faster/harder starting-gameplay and rethink the overall gameloop. A bunch of lifestreams, articles and early access-players over the past weeks inspired our work to adjust the right things in RECONNECT for an even smoother user-experience.


So, what has happend in details:

[h2]New Features[/h2]
RECONNECT creates individual time lines for each player. With every played round, the result (quit / reconnect / win / game over) will affect all future rounds/gameplay. Some players wanted more feedback in the game, to know where they actually are on their journey. Others wanted an overall speedup. Therefore we introduce these new features:

[list]
[*][h3]overall gameloop[/h3]

[list]
[*][b]AI-Scouts[/b] - Until you collected 10% of AI-data, scouts will spice up your building phase. Seeking and extracting data is their main goal, while you strengthen up the defence of your fragile source. Every spawning cycle of the AI, scouts exploring the map to find a source of energy/light. While you stay close in contact with the actual best AI-drones you can observe the development of their behaviour and optimize your network building decisions more quickly. Every new round the amount of scouts differs and evolves with saved AI networks to ensure the right amount of pressure you need to strengthen up your base and prepare for the "big wave".

[*][b]Reconnection-Screen[/b] - See the individual name, fitness and reached generation of your extracted artificial neural network alias [i]LightKnight[/i] and the ingame play time. Enjoy the music of the source by watching the waves of the swarm from above. Every reconnection you finished you earn one [i]LightKnight[/i], which spawns spores in the next round to take over replicators.

[*][b]Game Over-Screen[/b] - You know when it is over. The game now slows down, deactivates your builder-tools and give you the name of the first replicator, which destroyed your light-source and therefore was saved. Keep in mind, next round the AI uses this knowledge to grow faster.

[*][b]Final Decision[/b] - This is the realm you started in and in which you will return, when you really "beat" the AI. [spoiler]You will then be confronted with a decision, where you can continue with all of your collected [i]LightKnights[/i] and saved [i]Replicators[/i] or finally delete all AI data and win the game. Winning the game means, that you have access to the ingame (cheat)terminal, to mutate the world after your needs..[/spoiler]
There is an ongoing discussions about new geometric maps and skins you can achieve. Maybe next update? ;)

[*][b]Save Recovery[/b] - We appreciate the hours you played RECONNECT! That's why we update your save data when you start the game for the first time after this update. All reconnections, LightKnights, Replicators or Coins will be transferred and should be working fine. If not, find us on our discord server for help -> [url=https://discord.gg/kxScbxEf]discord[/url]
On the other hand, you can delete your save-data and reset RECONNECT, when you delete this folder: [i]C:\\Users\\%USERNAME%\\AppData\\LocalLow\\RobotHeart Lab\\Reconnect[/i]

[/list]

[*][h3]other changes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Coin-text-system rework - specialized for spores, new endings and scouts
[*] screenshot key now F11 (not F12 - steam button conflict) - help screens updated
[*] blue towers: selector and layers updated
[*] main menu sound filter rework
[*] main menu newest LightKnight highlighted
[*] LightKnight count saved in every round - ReSt.ipc
[*] replicator balance bar show time optimized
[*] collectable upgrades rearranged
[*] various script speed up
[*] a lot of minor and major bugfixes
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]
Thank You for playing RECONNECT! <3[/h2]

notes.title: !!! 2-13f3 - critical benchmark bugfix !!!
notes.notes:
[b]A big sorry for all players who bought RECONNECT after the last update 2-13f2.[/b]

The HUD-Update caused an error on the Benchmark-scene activation, setting the global quality-settings to the absolut minimum. And that is totally not playable at all...

[b]But this is now fixed! [/b]

[h2]The only thing you have to do is:[/h2]

[olist]
[*]Please go to your RECONNECT-save-data-folder 
[b]C:\\Users\\%USERNAME%\\AppData\\LocalLow\\RobotHeart Lab\\Reconnect[/b]
[i](if you cannot see the "AppData"-folder, activate Windows-option "show hidden files/folders")[/i]

[*]In that folder [b]delete [/b]the "QualitySettings.rqs"-file to reactivate the Benchmark

[*][b]Start [/b]RECONNECT 

[*]Let the Benchmark process finish to generate the best quality settings for your actual hardware
[i](after it has finished, a new "QualitySettings.rqs"-file is generated)[/i]
[/olist]

[i]
Please, contact us at the "Official RECONNECT Early Access Hub" server on discord, if you experience any bugs. -> [url=https://discord.gg/Aq8DVnAQc3]https://discord.gg/Aq8DVnAQc3[/url][/i]

notes.title: Release Update 2-13f2 - HUD upgrade and bugfixes
notes.notes:
[b]New Feautures:[/b]

HUD upgrade:
[olist]
[*] Introducing the Quant-Bar, which shows the actual amount of Light-Quants in your light-network. It is located on the left side of the screen in the building mode.
[*] Introducing the Balance-Bar above the Quant-Storage-Count on the bottom of the screen. It is only activated when the balance between normal and infected Replicators has changed. This can happen when you infect AI-Replicators through your spores with light. A discrete value in percent is placed above of the black and white Balance-Bar. (Design Question: What happens by 100% ? ;) )
[/olist]

Other:
[list]
[*] Cosmic Assistance decision text on first game start full rework
[*] Commander-Terminal now only activates after first Reconnection
[*] source code speedup for Replicator, Light-Knights, various towers and the WebBuilder
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Munition of the red-tower is not correctly reloading - fixed!
[*] Dark Side audio loop playing, while infected Replicators are near base - fixed!
[*] Autoquality reduces quality on active enemy-base slowdown although fps are normal - fixed!
[*] Upgrade showing up an Reconnection-process - fixed
[*] and a lot more of minor fixes and optimisations..
[/list]

notes.notes:
